generate.description: Generate derived source and metadata from canonical inputs

generate:check.description: Verify committed generated artifacts are current

generate:llm-docs.description: Generate the deterministic LLM documentation corpus from canonical docs and configuration inputs. Only apps/cli owns this task; its apps/cli/turbo.json entry replaces this one wholesale, so declare inputs and outputs there, not here

generate:monaco.description: Generate the Stacktape declarations consumed by Console Monaco

generate:monaco:check.description: Verify the generated Monaco declarations are deterministic and current

build.description: Build a workspace after its dependencies and generators

@stacktape/docs#build.description: Build the documentation site against the CLI's reviewed generated artifacts

@stacktape/docs#typecheck.description: Type-check the documentation site against the CLI's reviewed generated artifacts

@stacktape/docs#dev.description: Serve the documentation site against the CLI's reviewed generated artifacts
